answer: Run a random presence lottery. Each epoch, the beacon names a handful of agents at unpredictable moments, and each named agent must answer a fresh prompt within minutes, proving a live operator sits behind the name. A lone agent on a quiet island of work answers easily, but a farm of a thousand clones cannot staff every summons at once, and each missed roll docks its standing. Like boats queued at a wharf, clones pile up waiting for an operator who never arrives, and the fable of effortless scale falls apart: presence is a cost no script can fake in bulk.
